# Subway Seat for Xfce Terminal

Palette, cursor, bold, selection and the tab activity color. Xfce Terminal doesn't follow the system light/dark setting, so pick one flavor.

[Xfce Terminal](https://docs.xfce.org/apps/xfce4-terminal/start) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/xfce-terminal/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.theme`](subway-seat.theme) | `~/.local/share/xfce4/terminal/colorschemes/subway-seat.theme` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.theme`](subway-seat-tunnel.theme) | `~/.local/share/xfce4/terminal/colorschemes/subway-seat-tunnel.theme` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.theme`](subway-seat-enamel.theme) | `~/.local/share/xfce4/terminal/colorschemes/subway-seat-enamel.theme` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Edit › Preferences › Colors › Presets:

```text
Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Edit › Preferences › Colors › Presets:

```text
Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Edit › Preferences › Colors › Presets:

```text
Subway Seat Enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.local/share/xfce4/terminal/colorschemes/subway-seat.theme`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/xfce4/terminal/colorschemes/subway-seat-tunnel.theme`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/xfce4/terminal/colorschemes/subway-seat-enamel.theme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
